answer: Paired-receipt bond blocks bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits on one bridge thread, filing one receipt sealed by a yarrow hash of thread, epoch, key. At dawn, neighbors swap receipts; auditors trace threads, and reused receipts or off-ledger threads burn both bonds. First filing 38, k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented threads burn too. Honest agents pay 38 once, keeping their bond.
